_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform, distinct from the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json manifest: that file registers the `png` reference crate under the `png-raster` capability its own create-and-round-trip-png case exercises; this file registers the SAME package under a distinct id and the `png-1-2-mutate` capability this subset's exhaustive mutation case (`mutate-png-1-2`) actually tags, per the wave 7 fleet brief's oracle-registration gotcha (reusing the shared entry fails the contract with `oracle-capability-mismatch`).

oracles.rationale: The same reference PNG encoder/decoder the shared png-raster entry already approves, registered under its own id and capability so this subset's exhaustive PngMutation catalog (17 kinds: header, palette, transparency, the typed ancillary set, text chunks, pixels and unknown-chunk retention) is measured against a reference implementation surveyed for exactly that capability rather than borrowing a neighbour's. Every mutation is applied independently against the `png` crate's own Encoder/Decoder API — never by reusing this repository's own decode_png/encode_png — so the comparison stays a genuine cross-check. Two chunk families are the documented exception and are read and written outside the crate's typed surface, because it has none for them: `Info` has no tIME field at all, and no accessor for chunk types it does not recognise. Both are recovered by a fixed-grammar walk over §5.3's length/type/data/crc chain and written back through `Writer::write_chunk`, the crate's own escape hatch. A third caveat is a defect in the crate rather than a gap: `Info::source_gamma` and `Info::source_chromaticities` are documented as the members to prefer over `gama_chunk`/`chrm_chunk` and are assigned nowhere in png 0.18.1, so a caller who follows that advice reads None for every file carrying a gAMA or cHRM chunk. This oracle reads the chunk members.

productionDebt.plan: Same pre-existing production reachability the shared ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json `png` entry already records (the OS host rasterizes SVG to PNG through this crate) — the dependency-classification gate classifies by reachability, not manifest placement, so registering the SAME package under a second id/capability here surfaces the same debt a second time rather than hiding it. Phase 7 target: once the OS host's PNG writing moves behind ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio's own encode_png, both this entry and the shared one lose their productionDebt and testOnly becomes a fact.
